checks.detail: fail. Provenance verified: every bound hash matches and both receipts report source_unchanged/binary_unchanged. The registered replay (native.host.0) passed all blocking checks (fresh build, embedded assets, product_ui_separation pass, session lifecycle) but drove only an invalid-email validation on the anonymous auth shell; its golden-path gate concludes state=unavailable because the product renders no #golden-path-probe element (grep-confirmed in the candidate). The release-critical PRD section-3 path is therefore unobserved at runtime for six loops, and section-9 conformance is judgeable only for the auth shell, which conforms (calm editorial canvas, restrained accent, inline field-level validation, no prohibited dark-blue panels). White-box evidence in the combined receipt (native.host.1) is strong: cargo fmt --check pass (independently re-verified), tsc/vite pass, 16/16 rust-unit incl. golden_path_section3_self_drive, restart persistence, generic-error rate limiting, single-use/expired/reused token recovery - but in-process self-drive is not live-UI runtime evidence. Advisory failures are host-check artifacts, not product signals: isolated_native_store probes com.focusboard.app vs identifier app.focusboard.desktop; source-contract/semantic-implementation expect commands.rs/storage.rs/App.ts while the candidate uses store.rs (10 CREATE TABLE, bundled rusqlite) and invoke() across six renderer modules. Closed find.rustfmt-style-debt and find.whitebox-lane-import-hijack on independent evidence; six issues remain open, five gated on the missing probe element.
